normalization: IP values remain unchanged; published [.] refanged in STIX already.
Cryptographic hashes matched case-insensitively; exact bytes retained. SSDEEP is case-sensitive exact text, not fuzzy scoring.
All four OR branches retained as independently required coverage assertions; this is stronger than satisfying a single OR indicator.
PDF filenames split explicit slash alternatives. Wildcards become matching patterns with fictional sample representatives; paths are fictional.
Hostnames remain hostnames; no invented DNS or published IP binding.
